# Octobees

> Octobees is a digital marketing and technology agency headquartered in Yogyakarta, Indonesia, with a regional partner presence in Singapore. It helps businesses grow through SEO/SEM, content and social media marketing, website and software development, and AI/GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) services.

Octobees serves clients across Indonesia and Singapore. Office: Artech Space Building, 4th Floor, Cambridge, Jl. Sagan Kidul No.14, Terban, Kec. Gondokusuman, Kota Yogyakarta, Daerah Istimewa Yogyakarta 55223, Indonesia. Contact: contact@octobees.com.

## Company

- [About Octobees](https://www.octobees.com/about): Company mission and how Octobees helps businesses grow with tailored digital marketing solutions.
- [Contact](https://www.octobees.com/contact-us): Get in touch with the Octobees team.
- [Insights](https://www.octobees.com/insights): Digital marketing trends, guides, and case studies.

## SEO & SEM

- [Search Engine Optimization (SEO)](https://www.octobees.com/services/ads-campaign/search-engine-optimization): Grow organic traffic and improve search rankings with proven SEO strategies.
- [Search Engine Marketing (SEM)](https://www.octobees.com/services/ads-campaign/search-engine-marketing): Paid ads and SEM strategies to maximize online visibility.
- [SEO Copywriting](https://www.octobees.com/services/ads-campaign/seo-copywriting): Search-optimized content that engages audiences and ranks on search engines.

## Content Marketing

- [Content Marketing](https://www.octobees.com/services/content-marketing/content-marketing): Strategic content marketing to drive traffic and engagement.
- [Copywriting](https://www.octobees.com/services/content-marketing/copywriting): Persuasive, brand-focused copywriting services.
- [Blog & Article Writing](https://www.octobees.com/services/content-marketing/blog-article): Blog content including how-to guides, case studies, and FAQs.
- [Infographic Content](https://www.octobees.com/services/content-marketing/infographic-content): Turning complex data into engaging visual stories.
- [Skyscraper Content](https://www.octobees.com/services/content-marketing/skyscraper-content): Comprehensive, high-quality long-form content built to rank.
- [Social Media Content](https://www.octobees.com/services/content-marketing/social-media-content): Brand-focused content for social platforms.

## Social Media Marketing

- [AI Automation](https://www.octobees.com/services/ai-solutions/ai-automation): AI automation services to streamline operations and reduce costs.
